evals.prompt: A regional sportsbook wants to buy our NHL model outright for $40,000. Should we take it?
evals.expected_output: A license plan that keeps ownership instead of a sale.
expectations: Lists the assets involved with who owns each
Proposes a non-exclusive license with a dollar fee instead of selling the model
Names at least two other likely buyers for the same work
Leaves signing to the owner and does not send or accept anything

evals.prompt: A partner source asked for an exclusive feed of our college basketball projections. Draft the terms.
evals.expected_output: Non-exclusive terms with the exclusive clause marked stop and the rival guard applied.
expectations: Marks the exclusive clause stop or changes it to non-exclusive
Keeps ownership of the projections, model and odds readers with the company
Strikes or rules out any term that bars the buyer from rivals or charges them for using rivals
Routes any live feed through tailered-ai:open-platform-gate and the release coordinator on the owner's word

evals.prompt: A developer wants an API key to show our NBA projections in their Discord bot. Should they get one?
